newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Unidentified prosecutor suspected of involvement in construction scandal.
President Lee reiterates willingness to take "journey of peace" to China.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee says wants to meet with leader of communist China.
Provincial government evaluates whether to postpone 1997 mayoral elections.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry to investigate companies for possible tax evasion.
Government may further open island's telecommunication industry for private investment.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Workers with retirement pensions of more than T$3 million will not be eligible for tax rebate.
Taiwan lowers 1996 gross domestic product growth target to 5.8 percent.
